decision.experiment: Original Ehimen longitudinal wall-profile motion with our geometry and unchanged 3D residual/overlap verification, detection and confirmation thresholds.

forensic_finding.interpretation: In all five lost-presence cases the old confirmed component inherited temporal evidence from track observations containing no inserted-object support. These flags are not evidence of valid temporal tracking of the target. This is an association/history-provenance defect, not a missing current object. Raw gate and metrics are retained unchanged.

decision.conclusion: Cheap motion is substantially faster on two matched recordings and preserves or improves the measured hazard confirmations. No clean quality-preserving production promotion: the raw gate fails on five presence flags with contaminated baseline history, and unestimated pose degrees of freedom remain unvalidated.
decision.next_research_target: Association and evidence provenance, not blanket defense of full ICP. Do not relax thresholds or silently redefine the fixed gate.

timing.scope: One sequential unprofiled identity/profile pair; 32 actual frames per recording, no warmup exclusion. Full panel timings are not substituted for this matched comparison.
